_comment: MCP server configuration for cAgents. Add MCP servers here to extend agent capabilities with external tools. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io for the full server registry.
_usage: Copy an entry from _examples into the top level, configure as needed, and remove the underscore-prefixed metadata fields.

playwright._description: Browser automation for web scraping, testing, and interaction. No auth required.

filesystem._description: Exposes a local filesystem directory to agents. Replace /path/to/allowed/dir.

github._description: GitHub API access via MCP. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.

fetch._description: HTTP fetch tool for retrieving web pages and APIs. Requires uv/uvx installed.

postgres._description: PostgreSQL query access. Set DATABASE_URL env var to your connection string.

slack._description: Slack workspace access for reading/posting messages. Requires bot token.
